investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Tidalfield Software (collaboration SaaS); Platform: AWS ap-northeast-1 (zones ap-northeast-1a/ap-northeast-1c/ap-northeast-1d); network range 10.58.0.0/16; Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-01, maxmemory 8gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the billing-api PostgreSQL database billing-db-01; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
